mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 3% indicates accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 3%.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k/month, a tightening labor market signals positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An INDPRO reading above 105 indicates strong industrial production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window with INDPRO > 105.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month RSAFS growth rate exceeding 5% signals strengthening consumer demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of quarters with RSAFS 3-month growth > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL move in opposite directions over 2 months, a potential monetary policy mismatch signals negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL 2-month delta signs differ
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An UNRATE reading above 5% indicates a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window with UNRATE > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST reading below 1200 signals weakening housing demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of months with HOUST < 1200.
